steps.npc: Hello again! I'm so glad to hear that you decided to join our family. Unfortunately, I'm all out of personal welcome packages, but I'm sure I'll have more soon.
That's right! They contain all the details on our Pillars of Progress, and also include a company branded mug!
As I say, I unfortunately don't have any available right now, but do let me know if there's anything else I can help you with.
